title: Syntax Error: Missing Brace
description: Program contains an unclosed block brace. The parser rejects the malformed syntax before semantic analysis.

title: Undeclared Variable
description: Variable 'y' is referenced before declaration. The semantic analyzer stops execution and reports the missing symbol.

title: Type Mismatch Assignment
description: Attempting to assign a 'word' string literal to a 'num' integer variable. Semantic analyzer enforces static type safety.

title: LV01: Always-False Condition
description: Condition 'x > 10 and x < 5' is contradictory and can never evaluate to true. The branch body will never execute.

title: LV02: Always-True Condition
description: Condition 'x equals 5' is always true based on constant propagation. The otherwise branch is dead code.

title: LV03: Self-Comparison
description: Comparing variable 'x' directly to itself is tautological and indicates redundant or confused logic.

title: LV04: Redundant Condition Part
description: In 'x > 10 and x > 5', the condition 'x > 5' is subsumed by 'x > 10', making one conjunct completely redundant.

title: LV05: Loop Body Never Runs
description: The loop condition is already true on entry ('i equals 10' where i=10). Because 'until' loops stop when true, the body never runs.

title: LV06: Loop Never Terminates
description: The loop exit condition is constant false and contains no internal stop statement, causing an infinite loop.

title: LV07: Step Skips Loop Exit
description: Counter starts at 0, steps by +2, but exit test checks for exact equality 'i equals 5'. The counter skips the exit value.

title: LV08: Loop Moves Wrong Direction
description: Loop condition waits for 'x equals 10' starting from 1, but the step decrements 'x--', moving strictly away from the target.

title: LV09: Code After Endless Loop
description: Statements located immediately following a non-terminating loop can never be reached during execution.

title: LV10: Definite Division by Zero
description: Divisor is statically proven to be constant zero. The program is guaranteed to trigger a runtime trap.

title: LV11: Division by Unchecked Input
description: A variable read directly from user input is used as a divisor without any non-zero validation guard.

title: No False Alarm: Guarded Division
description: Input divisor is guarded by 'check (n > 0)' before division. The verifier proves the division is safe and emits no warnings.

title: No False Alarm: Loop with Stop
description: Loop has condition 'until (false)' but contains a reachable 'stop' statement inside a branch. Verifier correctly allows it.

title: LV12: Missing Import (Type)
description: Program uses built-in type 'word' without importing library 'text'. The linker flags the missing module declaration.

title: LV12: Missing Import (Function)
description: Program calls library function 'maximum' without importing library 'math'.

title: LV13: Unknown Library
description: Program imports library 'banana' which does not exist in the compiler library registry.

title: LV14: Undefined Function Call
description: Function 'lengt' is called on imported library 'text'. The linker identifies the typo and suggests 'length'.

title: LV15: Duplicate Import
description: Library 'text' is imported multiple times. The linker warns about redundant imports.

title: LV16: Unused Import
description: Library 'math' is imported but none of its types or functions are ever referenced.

title: Link Error Blocks Logic Checks
description: Program has both an unimported type (LV12) and a division by zero (LV10). Link error stops the pipeline before intermediate code.

title: Countdown Loop
description: Clean loop counting down from 5 to 0. Passes all compiler stages and prints countdown values.

title: Standard Library Usage
description: Imports 'text' and 'math' libraries, manipulates strings and numbers, and prints results with zero warnings.

title: Safe User Input Processing
description: Reads input using input(), validates condition with check/otherwise, and executes safely.
